description: This file is an Android Activity class named MainActivity, which manages user interactions related to account management, including displaying accounts, handling account selection, and registering for account updates. It contains UI initialization, event handling, and account operations using the Android AccountManager API.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that interacts with the AccountManager to display accounts, listen for account updates, and handle account selection with UI components like Buttons and TextViews. Sets up listeners, dialogs, and manages lifecycle events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, initializes AccountManager and account update listener, shows a welcome dialog, and sets a button to display accounts and launch account picker.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes the account update listener when the activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from the account picker intent, displaying the selected account type or cancelation message.
